scope:
Archive completed fixed-width calibration with exact parser reproduction.

Keep cost, draft-acceptance, and lane-round records from every content window.
Raw source hashes and remapped offsets preserve trace provenance. This does not
turn instrumented calibration into a release throughput measurement.

configurations.filter: Cost-model, draft-observation, and lane-round records in all original content windows.

acceptance.scope: Summarize instrumented native draft observations; do not predict serving TPS.

acceptance.emitted_token_contract: Nonterminal unconstrained greedy verification emits the matched draft prefix plus one target-selected token.
acceptance.interpretation: Prefix acceptance among verified drafts, excluding terminal and constrained observations. Adaptive selection censors unverified drafts; this is not unconditional draft accuracy.
